thread:
ajay: Hey team — ping for reviews on PR #1898 (https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/1898). It's a small config patch for KestrelCorp private deployment: add enterprise override for cert thumbprint + lower-priority route to avoid blackholing. Need approval from eng-platform and security before merge. :eyes:

sophie: Taking a look now. can you paste the diff for the cert bit? don't want to accidentally pin wrong thumbprint.

ajay: sure — diff snippet:
```
- enterprise_cert: null
+ enterprise_cert:
+   thumbprint: "3f:2a:9b:7c:01:de:aa:11"
+   rotation_policy: "auto"
```
also changed route priority:
```
-  priority: 100
+  priority: 200  # deprioritize customer-specific route
```

ken: I'll run the quick e2e in staging, give me ~20m. @ci-bot can you re-run tests after I push the staging tag?

ci-bot: Build #5382 triggered by @ken — integration-tests: queued

ci-bot: integration-tests failed in e2e-vpc: timeout applying network policy. logs: `Error: timed out waiting for ingress` (retries 3/3)

maria: I can eyeball the cert thumbprint and validate with Kestrel's SRE. don't merge until I confirm. also +1 to deprioritizing the route, safe rollback plan?

ajay: thanks @maria. rollback is just revert the two lines in enterprise.yaml; will hold merge and add WIP tag. I'll add a changelog entry and ping security for approval. @security any objections to thumbprint rotation_policy="auto"?

security: quick note — auto rotation is okay if rotation is logged and we have KMS audit enabled. please link the KMS key ARN in the PR and add a note in the audit playbook. :thumbsup:

sophie: ok setting a review; left two small nit comments about comments and tests. once CI green and @maria confirms thumbprint, we can merge.

ajay: awesome — marking PR WIP. ping when tests pass. thanks! :pray:
